KarteaResourceFields

class KarteaResourceFields[source]

Bases: object

Single table of the resource fields (image/sound) of the config.

Class with only class attributes and class methods, following the KarteaPathConfig pattern: it is not instantiated.

Attributes:
IMAGEstr, class attribute

Image resource type (“image”, ResourceField.kind).

SOUNDstr, class attribute

Sound resource type (“sound”, ResourceField.kind).

MOD_EXTENSIONSdict[str, tuple[str, …]], class attribute

Extensions accepted in the mods folder, by type (lowercase). Sounds only in WAV.

ALLtuple[ResourceField, …], class attribute

All fields, in the edit screen order.

BY_NAMEdict[str, ResourceField], class attribute

Fields by name.

Notes

The preview names and required-field messages of ALL are marked with QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP in the _TR_VIEW_CONTEXT (“PlayerKarteaConfigEditView”) and _TR_CONTEXT (“PlayerKarteaConfigEditController”) contexts; they are translated with self.tr() where they are shown (i18n).

Methods

get

Return the field with the given name.

images

Return the image fields, in table order.

sounds

Return the sound fields, in table order.
classmethod get(name)[source]

Return the field with the given name.

Parameters:
namestr

Field name, e.g. “vehicle_image”.

Returns:
ResourceField

The field.

Raises:
KeyError

If there is no field with this name.

classmethod images()[source]

Return the image fields, in table order.

Returns:
tuple[ResourceField, …]

Fields whose kind is IMAGE.

Examples

>>> len(KarteaResourceFields.images())
9
classmethod sounds()[source]

Return the sound fields, in table order.

Returns:
tuple[ResourceField, …]

Fields whose kind is SOUND.

Examples

>>> KarteaResourceFields.sounds()[0].name
'positive_feedback_sound'
